units.locator: Article 15.2. Submission of a Questionnaire, Reporting Changes to Information Contained in the Questionnaire, and Verification of That Information
units.text: 2. A municipal servant shall notify the employer’s representative (employer) in writing of changes of which the servant becomes aware to information contained in the questionnaire.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15.2

units.locator: Article 15.2. Submission of a Questionnaire, Reporting Changes to Information Contained in the Questionnaire, and Verification of That Information
units.text: 3. The questionnaire form, including the list of information included in it and the procedure and time limits for updating that information, is established by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 15.2

units.locator: Article 15.2. Submission of a Questionnaire, Reporting Changes to Information Contained in the Questionnaire, and Verification of That Information
units.text: 4. Information contained in the questionnaire may be verified by decision of the employer’s representative (employer) or a person authorized by that representative. The personnel service of the municipal body verifies the information by sending written requests, including through state information systems, to public authorities and organizations possessing the relevant information. Public authorities and organizations possessing the relevant information are obliged to provide the requested information no later than one month after receiving the request.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 15.2

units.locator: Chapter 4. PROCEDURE FOR ENTRY INTO, PERFORMANCE AND TERMINATION OF MUNICIPAL SERVICE
units.text: Chapter 4. PROCEDURE FOR ENTRY INTO, PERFORMANCE AND TERMINATION OF MUNICIPAL SERVICE
units.label: Chapter 4. PROCEDURE FOR ENTRY INTO, PERFORMANCE AND TERMINATION OF MUNICIPAL SERVICE

units.text: Article 16. Entry into Municipal Service
units.label: Art. 16

units.text: 1. Citizens who have reached the age of 18, have command of the state language of the Russian Federation and meet the qualification requirements established under this Federal Law for filling municipal service positions are entitled to enter municipal service, provided that none of the circumstances specified in Article 13 of this Federal Law as restrictions related to municipal service is present.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 16

units.text: 2. Upon entry into municipal service and during its performance, no direct or indirect restrictions or advantages may be established on grounds of sex, race, ethnicity, origin, property or official status, place of residence, attitude to religion, beliefs, membership in public associations, or other circumstances unrelated to a municipal servant’s professional and work-related qualities.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 16

units.text: 3. Upon entry into municipal service, a citizen shall submit:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 1) an application requesting admission to municipal service and appointment to a municipal service position;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 2) the questionnaire provided for by Article 15.2 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 3) a passport;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 4) an employment record book and/or information on employment activity prepared in accordance with the procedure established by legislation, except where an employment agreement (contract) is being concluded for the first time;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 5) a document on education and qualifications;
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 6) a document confirming registration in the individual (personalized) record-keeping system, except where an employment agreement (contract) is being concluded for the first time;
units.label: Point 6 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 7) a certificate of registration of the individual with the tax authority at the place of residence in the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 7 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 8) military registration documents, for citizens in the reserve and persons liable to conscription for military service;
units.label: Point 8 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 9) a medical organization’s conclusion confirming the absence of a disease preventing entry into municipal service;
units.label: Point 9 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 10) information on income, property and property-related obligations provided for by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’;
units.label: Point 10 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 10.1) the information provided for by Article 15.1 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 10.1 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 11) other documents provided for by federal laws, Presidential decrees of the Russian Federation and Government resolutions of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 11 Part 3 Art. 16

units.text: 4. Information (other than information contained in the questionnaire) submitted under this Federal Law by a citizen upon entry into municipal service may be verified according to the procedure established by federal laws. Federal laws may establish additional requirements for verification of information submitted by a citizen upon entry into municipal service in particular municipalities.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 16

units.text: 5. If the verification provided for by part 4 of this Article establishes circumstances preventing the citizen from entering municipal service, the citizen shall be informed in writing of the reasons for refusal of admission to municipal service.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 16

units.text: 6. A citizen enters municipal service through appointment to a municipal service position on the terms of an employment contract in accordance with labor legislation, taking account of the special provisions of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 16

units.text: 7. A citizen appointed as head of the local administration following a competition to fill that position shall conclude a contract. The procedure for filling the position of head of the local administration under a contract, and for concluding and terminating a contract with a person appointed to that position under a contract, is determined by Federal Law No. 131-ФЗ of 6 October 2003 ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’. The standard form of contract with a person appointed as head of the local administration under a contract is approved by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 16

units.text: 8. A citizen’s entry into municipal service is formalized by an act of the employer’s representative (employer) appointing the citizen to a municipal service position.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 16

units.text: 9. The parties to the employment contract upon entry into municipal service are the employer’s representative (employer) and the municipal servant.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 17. Competition to Fill a Municipal Service Position
units.text: Article 17. Competition to Fill a Municipal Service Position
units.label: Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Competition to Fill a Municipal Service Position
units.text: 1. When filling a municipal service position in a municipality, the conclusion of an employment contract may be preceded by a competition in which applicants’ professional level and compliance with the established qualification requirements for the municipal service position are assessed.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Competition to Fill a Municipal Service Position
units.text: 2. The procedure for a competition to fill a municipal service position is established by a municipal legal act adopted by the municipality’s representative body. The procedure must provide for publication of the conditions of the competition, its date, time and location, and the draft employment contract at least 20 days before the competition. The total number of members of the competition commission in the municipality and the procedure for its formation are established by the municipality’s representative body. Where a competition is held to fill the position of head of a territorial body of the local administration entrusted with exercising some of the local administration’s powers in rural settlements located within a settlement, municipal okrug, urban okrug or inter-settlement territory, the procedure for forming the competition commission in the municipality must provide for the inclusion of candidates nominated by the citizens’ assembly in each of those rural settlements among the commission’s members.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Competition to Fill a Municipal Service Position
units.text: 3. The employer’s representative (employer) shall conclude an employment contract with and appoint to the municipal service position one of the candidates selected by the competition commission following the competition to fill that position.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 17

units.text: Article 18. Appraisal of Municipal Servants
units.label: Art. 18

units.text: 1. A municipal servant’s appraisal is conducted to determine whether the servant is suited to the municipal service position held. A municipal servant’s appraisal is conducted once every three years.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 18

units.text: 2. The following municipal servants are not subject to appraisal:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 18

units.text: 1) those who have held municipal service positions for less than one year;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 18

units.text: 2) those who have reached the age of 60;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 18

units.text: 3) pregnant women;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 18

units.text: 4) those on maternity leave or on leave to care for a child until the child reaches the age of three. Such municipal servants may be appraised no earlier than one year after returning from leave;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 18

units.text: 5) those holding municipal service positions under a fixed-term employment agreement (contract).
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 18

units.text: 3. Following a municipal servant’s appraisal, the appraisal commission decides whether the servant is suited to the municipal service position held. The commission may recommend incentives for individual municipal servants for their achievements at work, including promotion, and, where necessary, recommend improvements to the activities of the municipal servants being appraised. The appraisal results are communicated to the appraised municipal servants immediately after the voting results are determined. The appraisal materials are submitted to the employer’s representative (employer).
units.label: Part 3 Art. 18

units.text: 4. On the basis of appraisal results, the employer’s representative (employer) decides to reward individual municipal servants for their achievements at work or, within no more than one month from the appraisal, to demote a municipal servant with the servant’s consent. On the basis of appraisal results, the appraisal commission may recommend that individual municipal servants be sent for additional professional education.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 18

units.text: 5. If a municipal servant does not consent to demotion or cannot be transferred with their consent to another municipal service position, the employer’s representative (employer) may, within no more than one month from the appraisal, dismiss the servant from municipal service for being unsuited to the position held due to insufficient qualifications confirmed by the appraisal results. After that period expires, dismissal or demotion of the municipal servant on the basis of that appraisal is not permitted.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 18

units.text: 6. A municipal servant is entitled to challenge the appraisal results in court.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 18

units.text: 7. Regulations on the appraisal of municipal servants are approved by a municipal legal act in accordance with standard regulations on the appraisal of municipal servants approved by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 19. Grounds for Terminating an Employment Contract with a Municipal Servant
units.text: Article 19. Grounds for Terminating an Employment Contract with a Municipal Servant
units.label: Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Grounds for Terminating an Employment Contract with a Municipal Servant
units.text: 1. In addition to the grounds for terminating an employment contract provided for by the Labor Code of the Russian Federation, an employment contract with a municipal servant may also be terminated at the initiative of the employer’s representative (employer) in the event of:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Grounds for Terminating an Employment Contract with a Municipal Servant
units.text: 1) attainment of the maximum age established for holding a municipal service position;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Grounds for Terminating an Employment Contract with a Municipal Servant
units.text: 2) repealed with effect from 1 July 2021. — Federal Law No. 116-ФЗ of 30.04.2021;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Grounds for Terminating an Employment Contract with a Municipal Servant
units.text: 3) failure to comply with the restrictions and prohibitions related to municipal service established by Articles 13, 14, 14.1 and 15 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Grounds for Terminating an Employment Contract with a Municipal Servant
units.text: 4) imposition of an administrative penalty in the form of disqualification;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Grounds for Terminating an Employment Contract with a Municipal Servant
units.text: 5) acquisition by the municipal servant of foreign agent status.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Grounds for Terminating an Employment Contract with a Municipal Servant
units.text: 2. Extension of the period of municipal service is permitted for municipal servants who have reached the maximum age established for holding a municipal service position. Each extension of a municipal servant’s period of service may be for no more than one year.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19

units.locator: Chapter 5. WORKING (SERVICE) TIME AND REST TIME
units.text: Chapter 5. WORKING (SERVICE) TIME AND REST TIME
units.label: Chapter 5. WORKING (SERVICE) TIME AND REST TIME

units.text: Article 20. Working (Service) Time
units.label: Art. 20

units.text: The working (service) time of municipal servants is regulated in accordance with labor legislation.
units.label: Art. 20 · text

units.locator: Article 21. Leave of a Municipal Servant
units.text: Article 21. Leave of a Municipal Servant
units.label: Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Leave of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 1. A municipal servant is granted annual leave with retention of the municipal service position held and monetary remuneration, the amount of which is determined according to the procedure established by labor legislation for calculating average earnings.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Leave of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 2. A municipal servant’s annual paid leave consists of basic paid leave and additional paid leave.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Leave of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 3. A municipal servant is granted basic annual paid leave of 30 calendar days.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Leave of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 4. A municipal servant is granted additional annual paid leave for length of service (of no more than 10 calendar days), and in the cases provided for by federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Leave of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 5. The procedure and conditions for granting a municipal servant additional annual paid leave for length of service are determined by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Leave of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 5.1. A municipal servant subject to an irregular working day is granted additional annual paid leave of three calendar days for that working arrangement.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Leave of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 6. Upon a municipal servant’s written application, the employer’s representative (employer) may grant the servant leave without monetary remuneration for no more than one year.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Leave of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 7. A municipal servant is granted leave without monetary remuneration in the cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 21
